svg.title: Measured simulation trajectories with world-bootstrap uncertainty
svg.desc: Synthetic scalar-agent simulation; no human, clinical, or language-model data.
svg.text: Outcome-dependent participation changes the path of adaptation
Conflict + access friction; selection sensitivity beta = 3
Means across 20 worlds (10 seeds each); bands are pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals.
Actual saved values every 10 updates are joined by straight segments; no curve smoothing.
